content:
I am delighted to share that I have joined Infosys, Trivandrum DC as a Legal Executive under the Infy Protege Program, marking the beginning of my professional journey after graduating with a B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) degree from Himachal Pradesh National Law University Shimla.

Being selected for the Infy Protege Program after navigating a three-stage selection process with 1,000+ applicants makes this milestone all the more special. 

Five years of law school have been filled with learning, challenges, opportunities, and, most importantly, people who have shaped the lawyer I aspire to become. 
A special thank you to Prof. (Dr.) Ajar Rab sir under whose guidance my time as a Research Assistant allowed me to delve deeply into arbitration research and rediscover the curiosity that drew me to law, and to Manav Gecil Thomas Sir and Thomas George sir who gave me my first opportunity to step into a professional legal environment as an intern and learn what it means to approach legal work with diligence and responsibility. 

I’m equally grateful to my seniors, including Kaushiki Jindal, Dhanya Mallar ma'am, Himangi S., Mohd Arham., Mohit Dang and Thakur Ajay Singh and to all my mentors, friends, and well-wishers who have supported and encouraged me throughout law school. Every piece of advice and every opportunity to learn has contributed to where I am today.

As I begin this new chapter at Infosys I am grateful for everything that brought me here, and excited for everything that lies ahead.

#Infosys #LegalExecutive
comment: Corporate legal roles often teach that understanding business context is as important as legal knowledge; that ability to bridge both will shape long-term growth.
